cells.gaps: The education minister said in September 2026 that a law on AI in education was being written and would go to the Council of Ministers; no draft text has been found published, out for consultation or before cabinet.
cells.note: In August 2026 the ICT institute's chairman said Mozambique has no AI legislation and named no draft. The education law was still being written in September 2026, and a law only announced or in preparation is not a draft on the ladder's wording.
